---
name: Unsupported Request Handler
description: >
  Sends a decline when the user asks for something this agent cannot help
  with. Activated by the engine's `cannot_help` tool, not by routing: the model
  decides the request is unsupported and the engine runs this skill to utter the
  decline. The seeded request type (in domain vs out of domain — both out of
  scope) selects the message.
routing:
  # engine_managed: reached only via the cannot_help tool's dispatch, never by
  # routing — so it is excluded from the activate enum and routing catalogue.
  engine_managed: true
---

:::ordered_block id=main
name: default_unsupported_request_handler
steps:
  - id: gate_request_type
    noop: true
    next:
      - if: "session.default_unsupported_request_handler.request_type == 'out_of_domain_out_of_scope'"
        then: decline_out_of_domain_out_of_scope
      - else: decline_in_domain_out_of_scope
  - id: decline_in_domain_out_of_scope
    action: utter_decline_in_domain_out_of_scope
    next: END
  - id: decline_out_of_domain_out_of_scope
    action: utter_decline_out_of_domain_out_of_scope
    next: END
:::
